label: Infinite modal-carrier probability underdetermination
summary: Analyst derivation, attribution deferred. Reuses Kripke.Frame/Holds, Mathlib measures, existing finite FineTuningSelection and FineTuningEvidence boundaries. Proofs: no uniform point masses (constant zero sums to zero, constant nonzero to infinity); equal cardinality with unequal mass and modal freedom on a fixed Kripke frame both reuse the shared interior-mass lemma of #2143 (arbitraryInteriorMass, cb2b9ac7), which replaced this draft's duplicate geometric-mixture lemma; a two-vs-three partition obstruction already under finite additivity, incompatible full enumeration limits, and restricted Lebesgue measure. Reject the leap from equal cardinality or modal access to equal probabilities; also reject the leap from absence of a universal uniform prior to impossibility of justified probabilistic inquiry. Positive rival: an independently motivated generative law, measurable geometry or observer-weighting kernel selects a measure without requiring all-permutation invariance. Repair 2026-11-28: all seven remaining results build, bind and pass Comparator and NanoDa; the modal freedom statement now uses the shared InteriorRate and real-valued event mass. Scope: these are non-identification and impossibility-of-symmetric-measure results. No uniform or all-permutation-invariant probability exists on these carriers, but that is not the absence of every probability: point-positive non-uniform measures exist for every interior value.
blocker: Physical world-to-measure, observer-selection and actual designer bridges remain open; independent semantic challenge is pending.
